title: Slate Documentation — Random Labs
reason: Full implementation docs for Slate agent: thread DSL, episode API, context routing. Needed to evaluate thread weaving pattern for adoption in L-Thread orchestrator.

title: Context Rot — How Increasing Input Tokens Impacts LLM Performance (Chroma, 2025)
reason: Quantifies context window degradation across 4 frontier models (Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-4.1, Qwen3-32B, Gemini 2.5 Flash). Key evidence for compaction strategy decisions and working memory budget allocation.

title: Shortcut (formerly Altera / Project Sid) — PIANO Architecture
reason: Altera's PIANO architecture enables parallel async multi-agent processing with system 1/system 2 synchronization. Only multi-agent system in the Slate taxonomy that supports parallel execution besides Slate itself.
